sections.heading: if / else
sections.markdown: Every control-flow condition must have type `bool`. Nullable presence is written explicitly as `value != null`; integers, strings and objects have no implicit condition conversion.

sections.heading: for / for-in
sections.markdown: Ordinary for-in holds a logical snapshot. The settled reference-iteration contract uses for (ref x in xs) or for (i, ref x in xs) for Array, fixed arrays and MutSlice, and for (k, ref v in m) for Map values with read-only keys. It borrows the container once, detaches COW before iteration and writes actual elements. Other-path container access and length changes conflict. Each iteration ref ends at iteration exit, while the container loan ends at loop exit. Current implementation qualification is specified in spec §17.
